subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers adopt the open cross-repo fork PR for this Feishu quoted-mention bug, ask for a narrow refreshed replacement, or sponsor a small in-repo fix?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but an open conflicting cross-repo PR still claims this issue and current labels explicitly prevent queueing a duplicate automated fix PR.

options.title: Request a narrow refreshed fix
options.body: Ask the contributor or an area owner to replace the stale broad branch with a focused `send.ts` and `send.test.ts` repair for fetched-message mention normalization.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR after narrowing
options.body: Keep the cross-repo PR as the candidate only if it is rebased, trimmed to the Feishu parser/test surface, and supplies focused proof.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer-owned fix
options.body: Close or detach the stale candidate and have an area owner land the small parser-boundary repair directly.

recommendation.title: Request a narrow refreshed fix
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor or an area owner to replace the stale broad branch with a focused `send.ts` and `send.test.ts` repair for fetched-message mention normalization.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent Feishu mention-rendering repair history among the likely owners found.
